description: Angular component for selecting and managing entity gateways, including creating new gateways, filtering, and loading gateway list.

classes.name: EntityGatewaySelectComponent
classes.description: Angular component for selecting and managing entity gateways, with functionalities for filtering, creating, and displaying gateways.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component, sets up form controls, loads gateway list, and sets up filtered gateways observable.

methods.name: fetchGateway
methods.description: Filters the gateway list based on search text and returns an observable of matching devices.

methods.name: onFocus
methods.description: Handles focus event on the input, updates form control validity if dirty.

methods.name: displayGatewayFn
methods.description: Returns the display name of a gateway device.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Sets the disabled state of the component (empty implementation).

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Writes a value to the component, resets search text if null.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the search text and optionally hides the list.

methods.name: textIsNotEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the provided text is non-empty.

methods.name: gatewayNameEnter
methods.description: Handles Enter key press to create a new gateway if none is selected.

methods.name: createGateway
methods.description: Initiates creation of a new gateway after user confirmation.

methods.name: createDeviceGateway
methods.description: Creates a new device gateway, updates list and form control.

methods.name: loadGatewayList
methods.description: Loads the list of gateways based on user authority and filters.

methods.name: updateView
methods.description: Propagates the change to the form control.
